job.jobSummary: BUMP is hiring a Frontend Developer for its Prediction Markets team to build and maintain a secure, multi-tenant prediction-market platform for Latin American markets. coreResponsibilities: Design, build, test, and maintain React and Next.js web applications

Support ongoing enhancements that improve system stability, supportability, and overall service performance

descriptionText:
BUMP is hiring a Frontend Developer for its Prediction Markets team to build and maintain a secure, multi-tenant prediction-market platform for Latin American markets. The role focuses on the mobile-first customer trading application, with additional work on administrative and operational tools, API integrations, testing, and production support.

Design, build, test, and maintain React and Next.js web applications
Develop responsive, mobile-first customer experiences using TypeScript
Build reusable, accessible, and maintainable components using the platform's design system
Translate business, product, and design requirements into scalable application features
Build interfaces that support multilingual, multi-currency, and regional user experiences, including language, date, time, and number formatting
Contribute to the design and development of secure multi-tenant and white-label platform capabilities
Develop and enhance customer-facing workflows supporting market discovery, search, filtering, and category navigation
Build event and market-detail experiences that present real-time pricing, order-book information, and market data
Develop transaction workflows including outcome selection, bet slips, price locks, fees, order confirmation, and settlement status
Create interfaces for managing open positions, working orders, transaction history, and trade activity
Ensure customer-facing transaction states and financial information are displayed clearly, accurately, and consistently
Deliver localized customer experiences that support multiple languages and currencies
Design and maintain administrative and operational interfaces supporting market curation and platform operations
Develop finance, reconciliation, and treasury-monitoring dashboards and reporting solutions
Build audit-trail views to support compliance, operational transparency, and system traceability
Create internal tools that support customer service, player management, and operational support activities
Integrate frontend applications with REST and GraphQL services to deliver secure and scalable functionality
Implement real-time user experiences using WebSockets to display live prices, scores, account activity, order status, and operational alerts
Support secure integration of platform capabilities within external customer environments using iFrame and browser messaging technologies
Collaborate with backend engineers to define, implement, and maintain API contracts and real-time event integrations
Develop and maintain unit, component, integration, accessibility, Storybook, and end-to-end testing assets
Troubleshoot and resolve browser, network, rendering, state-management, and TypeScript-related issues
Monitor, analyze, and improve application performance, accessibility, reliability, and user experience

Collaborate with Service Desk, Technical Support, and engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and restore platform services

Legally eligible to work in Canada
Fluent in English (speak, read, write)
1 year of experience developing web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks and TypeScript
Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js in production environments
Experience building responsive, mobile-first, and accessible user interfaces

Experience with financial services, trading, gaming, betting, lottery, or other transaction-heavy platforms
Experience building multilingual, multi-currency, or internationalized applications
Experience with design systems, Storybook, and reusable component libraries
Experience working with secure multi-tenant or white-label SaaS solutions
Experience embedding applications within external portals using iFrames and browser messaging technologies
Knowledge of frontend performance optimization, accessibility standards, and secure development practices
Experience working in cloud-native environments and collaborating with distributed engineering teams
Experience supporting production systems, participating in on-call rotations, and resolving live service incidents
Benefits
An industry-leading defined contribution pension plan with company matching contributions (up to 5%) and payment of service fees
Best-in-class health, medical, and life insurance benefits
Access to virtual and telehealth services and apps
Very progressive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits to support all definitions of family
Hybrid work model
Company Overview
Originally established in 1897 to supply security printed products to the Government of Canada, Canadian Bank Note Company, Limited (CBN) continues to provide goods and services in Canada including: currency; passports and ePassports; driver license and identification cards; biometric solutions; postage stamps; permanent resident cards; visas; and vital statistics documents. It was founded in 1897, and is headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, CAN, with a workforce of 1001-5000 employees. Its website is https://www.cbnco.com/.
